title: Keto-Friendly Flaky Polish Coconut Cream Pancakes
description: A Polish-inspired breakfast dish with coconut cream, almond flour, and parsley, perfect for hangover morning. This keto-friendly pancake is not just a treat, but a hangover cure.

ingredients.name: Large egg
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use room temperature eggs

ingredients.name: Coconut cream
ingredients.notes: Chill the can in the fridge overnight

ingredients.name: Almond flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use fine-mesh almond flour

ingredients.name: Granulated sweetener
ingredients.notes: Use your preferred sweetener, but keep it keto-friendly

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use melted butter

ingredients.name: Baking powder
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a gluten-free baking powder

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whip the coconut cream until it's stiff and holds its shape.
Add the melted butter, egg, and chopped parsley to the coconut cream and mix until combined.
Gradually pour the dry ingredients into the coconut cream mixture and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and grease it with a small amount of butter.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your preferred toppings, such as fresh berries, whipped cream, or maple syrup.
